summary_en: Update to June 2024 capital-cost and share-price management framework. Board reviewed current performance and revised improvement roadmap on 3 June 2026. Specific targets and metrics not disclosed in excerpt.
title_en: Update on Initiatives for Management Conscious of Capital Cost and Share Price
translation_en_brief: Japan Foundation Engineering Co., Ltd. announced on 3 June 2026 that its Board of Directors reviewed and updated the capital-cost and share-price management initiatives originally disclosed on 4 June 2024. The company has analysed current performance and established revised action plans to improve execution. The disclosure provides no specific metrics, targets, or financial thresholds in the excerpt presented, indicating a framework update rather than a quantitative COC goal reset.
